title: My Laundry Machine Kept Running at 3 AM (Part 2)
script: Last week I found out someone was washing my lost hoodie at 3 AM, and leaving notes in my handwriting. So I hid a camera in the laundry room. At 2:58, the door opened. It was me. Same gray hoodie, same messy bun, eyes wide open. She loaded the machine, wrote a sticky note, and stuck it on the lid. Fine, I thought. I'm sleepwalking. Then I checked my smartwatch. At 2:58 it said I was in bed. Deep sleep. Heart rate fifty-two. I watched the video again. Right before she left, the girl in my hoodie turned, looked straight into the hidden camera, and held up the note so I could read it. It said: Don't open the dryer yet. Follow for the final part.
description: Part 2: a hidden camera shows who has been doing the laundry at 3 AM. This is a fictional story.
